Avatar Exporter

Bring the avatar you set up for VRChat into VCam and VCam Camera as a VRM.

Add to VCC GitHub
Listing URL $listing_url

Install with VCC

  1. Select Add to VCC above, or in the VRChat Creator Companion go to Settings > Packages > Add Repository and enter the listing URL.
  2. If you have not added the Modular Avatar listing, which provides NDMF, add https://vpm.nadena.dev/vpm.json the same way.
  3. Select Manage Project on your avatar's project and add VCam Avatar Exporter. VCC installs NDMF and UniVRM with it.
  4. If the project does not have lilToon 2.3.4, install it from lilToon's own distribution. Then open Tools > VCam Avatar Exporter in Unity.

What it does

Keeps your outfit

Exports the avatar as it is after Modular Avatar and other non-destructive tools have run.

Moves its face

Mouth shapes, blinks and ARKit shape keys become VRM expressions and Perfect Sync.

Brings your expressions

Expressions from hand gestures and expression menus become VRM expressions.

Keeps hair swaying

PhysBones are converted to VRM spring bones.

Works in other VRM apps

Every material is exported as MToon, along with your lilToon settings.

Leaves your project untouched

Export works on a copy of the avatar.

Check your avatar's terms of use before you export. Some avatars do not allow use outside VRChat or conversion to VRM.
